title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Mandatory Withdrawal - Incompetence
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: Three months into representing a client at a specialized agricultural tribunal, the paralegal realizes the matter has become extraordinarily complex, and the paralegal lacks the competence to handle it. The client refuses to hire associate counsel because of costs, and the paralegal cannot learn the law without immense delay. What must the paralegal do?
options: Continue the representation and do their best, since the client has refused co-counsel.
Permissively withdraw, but only if the client consents.
Charge the client a higher rate to compensate for the extra research time needed.
questions.explain: Rule 8.02 (Mandatory Withdrawal) requires a paralegal to withdraw if they are not competent to handle the matter. If the paralegal cannot become competent without undue delay or expense to the client, and the client refuses to associate with a competent licensee, the paralegal *must* withdraw.
